collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager's stubbed toe has healed, but the limp brings drinks and the shady seat: keep limping, or stop limping.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) stubbed (subject.his/her) toe on a root this morning. It hurt quite a lot, for a while. It doesn't hurt much now. But (subject) has noticed that, while (subject.he/she) is limping, people carry things for (subject.him/her), give (subject.him/her) the shady seat and bring (subject.him/her) drinks. (subject.He/she) is still limping. (subject.He/she) is also, slightly, enjoying it.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: That evening the dancing begins, and (subject)'s favorite song starts, and (subject.he/she) forgets all about the toe and dances all night. The next morning (friend) brings (subject.him/her) a drink, raises an eyebrow, and asks, "How's the toe?" "...Much better," says (subject). "Amazing," says (friend), and leaves the drink anyway.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: By midday (subject) stops limping and goes back to carrying (subject.his/her) own things. It's a little disappointing to be ordinary again. Then (friend) turns up with a drink anyway, "for being brave about the toe." (subject) decides that this is the best of both worlds.
